issues.detail: The Greek 'και ο θεος και πατηρ ημων' implies that Jesus Christ is both God and our Father (or 'the God and our Father'). The Vietnamese translation separates them into two distinct entities: 'Chúa Giê-xu Christ, và Đức Chúa Trời là Cha chúng ta', which could be interpreted as 'Jesus Christ, and [someone else] God who is our Father'.
